sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use familiar present-tense verb forms to describe repeated daily activities.

These are the same present-tense forms you already drilled — dolgozom, olvasok — just now doing double duty to describe routines and habits, not just one-off actions. Hungarian doesn’t have a separate ‘habitual’ verb form the way some languages do; the plain present tense already covers both ‘I work’ and ‘I work every morning’ equally well.
